context.current_question: I am an international applicant interested in the Construction Management Diploma. Is it available to international applicants?
So does that automatically mean I'm admitted?
What can you actually verify, and what should I confirm with BCIT?

definitions.E6:
Yes. The **Construction Management Diploma** is available to international applicants.

It is a part-time, blended program delivered online and at Burnaby Campus. A valid BCIT study permit is required before starting. [View the program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-diploma-part-time-7710dipma/)

For more information, see BCIT International Students: https://www.bcit.ca/international-students/.
definitions.E3:
No. Being an international applicant means you’re eligible to apply; it does **not** guarantee admission.

You must provide proof of Category 2 English proficiency—English Studies 12 with at least 67% or equivalent. Admission is first-qualified while space remains, and BCIT must assess your application. A valid BCIT study permit is also required before starting the program.

[View admission requirements](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-diploma-part-time-7710dipma/)
definitions.E7:
Your international status establishes only that you may apply; it does not establish admission.

**I can verify:**
- Construction Management is an active, part-time Diploma delivered online and at Burnaby Campus in a blended format.
- Admission requires Category 2 English proficiency—English Studies 12 with at least 67%, or an equivalent.
- Qualified applicants are admitted on a first-qualified basis while space remains.
- The curriculum contains required courses and an elective pool—for example, **BLDT 2021 – Basic Project Management Skills** is required, while **ACED 1305 – Introduction to Systems – Structural, Mechanical & Electrical** is in the elective pool.

**Still missing from your stated facts:**
- Evidence that you meet the English requirement.
- Confirmation that space is available and BCIT has accepted your application.
- Confirmation of your valid study-permit status before starting.

**Confirm with BCIT:**
- Whether your specific English credential is considered equivalent.
- Current intake availability, document requirements, and your admission decision.
- Any study-permit questions affecting enrolment. PGWP approval must ultimately be confirmed with IRCC.

[Construction Management Diploma program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-diploma-part-time-7710dipma/)
definitions.E1: Delivery: blended. See details . About the program The Construction Management Diploma program will provide students with sufficient technical and general knowledge and skills to effectively perform project management responsibilities in the construction industry. At the same time, graduates of the program will be able to apply and continue their education through the Bachelor of Technology in Construction Management program, equipping them to perform at a higher level of construction project management.
